##### Project general facts

Sera 1 at Rashid Yachts & Marina by Emaar Properties is a refined waterfront residential development designed to reflect a modern maritime lifestyle. The project consists of two architecturally connected buildings, offering a collection of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, as well as exclusive 3-bedroom townhouses. Defined by soft sand tones and elegant coastal design, the architecture blends seamlessly with the marina setting, creating a serene and upscale living environment.

The development delivers a resort-style lifestyle through a wide range of thoughtfully curated amenities. Residents can enjoy swimming pools, a fully equipped gym, yoga platforms, paddle and basketball courts, as well as an amphitheater and landscaped relaxation areas. Additional features include BBQ zones, children’s play areas, water gardens, and scenic walking promenades, all designed to create a vibrant yet tranquil community by the waterfront.

The interiors are designed with a focus on space, light, and modern elegance, featuring premium finishes and large windows that enhance natural brightness and marina views. Expansive windows and open-plan layouts enhance the feeling of space, making every residence ideal for both families and individuals. Each residence is carefully planned to combine comfort with refined aesthetics, ensuring a high standard of living throughout. Residences are offered unfurnished.

##### Location description and benefits

Rashid Yachts & Marina is the new global destination for discerning yacht owners to experience Dubai’s buzzing scene in an elegant environment where beauty and luxury collide. Designed to encapsulate the ultimate modern waterfront architecture, it combines luxury residences and a full-service marina with an appealing mix of restaurants and shops.

The new Marina at Rashid Yachts & Marina offers convenient, hassle-free access to Dubai, accommodating 430 wet berths for yachts up to 100m long with a range of flexible berthing options, from a single night through to seasonal and annual stays. You will benefit from the Marina’s state-of-the-art facilities, an expert, multilingual marina team offering yacht assistance around the clock, and a host of amenities and services you will find at your disposal.

A luxurious residential haven with modern amenities, beautiful scenery, and access to exciting local hotspots, Rashid Yachts & Marina is the perfect place to relax and explore in proximity to some of Dubai’s most exciting attractions.
